capabilities: Open a chosen note, canvas, base, or workspace on startup
Launch the homepage from a ribbon button or command
Run any Obsidian command when the homepage opens
Choose how leftover tabs are handled at startup
Open the homepage in Reading, Source, or Live Preview
disambiguation: Not a website or publishing homepage; it sets which existing note, canvas, base, or workspace opens when the app starts.
extras: Pre-release versions can be installed manually or via BRAT, and the README warns these revisions do not always receive the full testing of official releases.
problem: Obsidian reopens whatever was last on screen, with no built-in way to designate a fixed landing note or workspace on startup.

relations.evidence: Works effectively with other plugins such as Dataview or Obsidian Bases to create advanced landing pages.

summary: Startup homepage plugin that opens a chosen note, canvas, base, or workspace when Obsidian launches or on demand.
